feed.title: Kansas City's midtown Costco closes Oct. 1. It'll reopen next year — with no food court or pharmacy
feed.summary: The Costco store in Midtown Kansas City is closing on October 1st and will reopen next spring as a Costco Business Center. This conversion means the store will focus on supplies for restaurants, small shops, and offices, omitting many typical Costco offerings like the food court, pharmacy, clothing, and liquor sales. Despite local opposition, the change is proceeding, driven by the company's aim to optimize sales in a location that, while successful enough to repay public tax breaks early, reportedly underperformed in general merchandise compared to its strong liquor sales.
